intuition: Each query partitions an inclusive time range into fixed-width buckets and counts timestamps in each bucket.

brute_force.approach: Store every tweet timestamp and scan all records for each requested bucket.

optimal.approach: Keep sorted timestamps per tweet and use binary-search boundaries to count each bucket.
optimal.time: recordTweet O(n), query O(buckets log n)

edge_cases: The final bucket may be shorter than the selected frequency.
Buckets with no tweets still appear with count zero.
